classes.name: Warrior
classes.hook: Shield Bash stuns enemies. Whirlwind hits all adjacent foes. Unbreakable when outnumbered.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4L8 14v8l10 10 10-10v-8L18 4z"/><path d="M18 4v28M8 14h20"/></svg>

classes.name: Fighter
classes.hook: Riposte counters parries. Tactical stances swap between offense and defense. Precise Strike never misses.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 3v26"/><path d="M14 7l4-4 4 4"/><path d="M10 29h16"/><path d="M6 18l6-3 6 3 6-3 6 3"/></svg>

classes.name: Paladin
classes.hook: Holy Strike crits vs demons. Lay on Hands keeps allies alive. Consecration sustains long fights.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 3l-14 6v9c0 8 7 14 14 16 7-2 14-8 14-16V9L18 3z"/><path d="M12 18l4 4 8-8"/></svg>

classes.name: Ranger
classes.hook: Aimed Shot ignores armor. Rain of Arrows blankets the entire enemy field for 3 rounds.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M5 5l26 26M5 5l8 2-2-8"/><circle cx="24" cy="12" r="4"/></svg>

classes.name: Rogue
classes.hook: 200% Backstab on stunned targets. Death Mark makes enemies take 50% more damage from all sources.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M10 26L26 10M18 10l8-2-2 8"/><path d="M10 26c-2 2-4 2-4 0s0-2 2-4"/></svg>

classes.name: Cleric
classes.hook: Mass Resurrection can auto-trigger on wipe. Sanctuary makes an ally temporarily untargetable.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4v28M4 18h28"/></svg>

classes.name: Bard
classes.hook: Ballad of Valor gives one hero two turns per round. Song of Ruin strips all enemy buffs at once.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M8 28c0-3 3-5 8-5s8 2 8 5"/><path d="M14 23V10l12-3v13"/><circle cx="10" cy="28" r="3"/><circle cx="24" cy="25" r="3"/></svg>

classes.name: Mage
classes.hook: Fireball torches entire enemy packs. Blizzard hits all enemies for 3 rounds. Arcane Surge: 400% INT.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4l3 10h10l-8 6 3 10-8-6-8 6 3-10-8-6h10z"/></svg>

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.hook: Raise Dead turns corpses into skeleton allies. Death Coil applies Poison AND Bleed to all enemies.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="18" cy="14" r="8"/><path d="M14 14v5M22 14v5M10 28c0-5 4-9 8-9s8 4 8 9"/></svg>

classes.name: Warlock
classes.hook: Corruption spreads on enemy death. Soul Pact doubles all DoT at cost of own HP.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4c-4 6-8 8-8 14a8 8 0 0016 0c0-6-4-8-8-14z"/><path d="M14 22c0 2.2 1.8 4 4 4s4-1.8 4-4"/></svg>

classes.name: Demon Hunter
classes.hook: +50% damage vs demons. Vengeance stacks from fallen allies then unleashes devastating burst.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M6 30L18 6l12 24"/><path d="M11 22h14"/><path d="M18 6v5"/></svg>

classes.name: Scavenger
classes.hook: Lucky Strike inflicts random statuses. Big Score is a high-variance gambling strike — crit huge or whiff.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><rect x="10" y="16" width="16" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M6 16h24M14 16v-4a4 4 0 018 0v4"/></svg>

classes.name: Swashbuckler
classes.hook: Build Flair stacks with Flourish. Grandeur releases all stacks in one legendary strike.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M6 30L30 6M22 6l8-2-2 8"/><path d="M6 30a4 4 0 004-4"/></svg>

classes.name: Dragon Knight
classes.hook: Choose fire/ice/lightning. Draconic Fury turns all attacks into group AoE for 2 rounds.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4c6 4 12 10 12 16s-6 12-12 12S6 26 6 20c0-6 6-12 12-16z"/><path d="M18 4c-3 6 0 14 0 18"/><path d="M8 16c4-2 8-2 10 0"/></svg>

classes.name: Pyromancer
classes.hook: Stack Burn on multiple groups. Meteor ignites every enemy group simultaneously.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4c-2 8 6 10 2 18a8 8 0 01-8-8c0-2 1-4 2-5-1 4 2 6 4 4 2-8-4-6-4-14"/><path d="M18 22a4 4 0 000 8"/></svg>

classes.name: Stormcaller
classes.hook: Chain Lightning jumps between enemies. Thunder Ring zones the battlefield.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M20 3L8 20h8l-4 13 16-19h-8l4-11z"/></svg>

classes.name: Druid
classes.hook: Rejuvenation HoTs. Wild Shape for raw damage. Nature’s Wrath in the late game.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4c-8 6-8 18 0 26 8-8 8-20 0-26z"/><path d="M18 10v20"/></svg>

classes.name: Oracle
classes.hook: Foresight pre-shields allies against incoming damage. Prophecy reveals enemy intents.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="14"/><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="4"/></svg>

classes.name: Tactician
classes.hook: Grants extra actions, repositions allies, reshuffles enemy turn order.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><rect x="5" y="5" width="26" height="26"/><path d="M5 13h26M5 22h26M14 5v26M23 5v26"/></svg>

classes.name: Chronomancer
classes.hook: Haste allies, slow enemies, rewind HP, freeze the battlefield in Time Stop.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="14"/><path d="M18 8v10l7 4"/></svg>

classes.name: Monk
classes.hook: Unarmed flurries stack chi. Inner Focus self-heals. Shadow Step dashes into crit range.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="18" cy="10" r="5"/><path d="M10 30l4-10h8l4 10M14 20v-4M22 20v-4"/></svg>

classes.name: Shaman
classes.hook: Totems heal over time. Spirit bolts chain to nearby foes. Ancestral Shield wards the party.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4v28M10 12l8-8 8 8M10 20l8-4 8 4M10 28l8-4 8 4"/></svg>

classes.name: Witch Hunter
classes.hook: Silver bolts purge curses. Bonus damage vs demons and undead. Marks targets for the party.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M6 30L30 6M22 10l4-4 4 4-4 4z"/><circle cx="12" cy="24" r="3"/></svg>

classes.name: Knight
classes.hook: Shield Bash stuns, Taunt locks aggro, Holy Strike sears evil, Rally bolsters the party.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4l-12 5v10c0 7 5 12 12 14 7-2 12-7 12-14V9L18 4z"/><path d="M18 10v16M12 18h12"/></svg>

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.hook: Wild Bolt rolls a random element. Arcane Surge doubles spell power. Mana Burn punishes casters.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4l4 10 10 2-8 6 2 10-8-6-8 6 2-10-8-6 10-2z"/></svg>

classes.name: Runesmith
classes.hook: Rune Hammer hits with imbued force. Wards protect allies. Forge Flame ignites weapons.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M8 28h20M12 28V14l6-10 6 10v14"/><path d="M16 18h4M16 22h4"/></svg>

classes.name: Shadow Dancer
classes.hook: Smoke Veil grants evasion. Assassinate executes low-HP foes. Dance of Blades chains strikes.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M8 28L24 12M12 28L28 12M20 8l6-2-2 6"/></svg>

classes.name: Tinker
classes.hook: Clockwork bolts, alchemical grenades, and a pocket-watch that patches wounds mid-fight. Overcharge the whole party with an arcane spring-wound battery.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="10"/><path d="M18 8v4M18 24v4M8 18h4M24 18h4M11 11l3 3M22 22l3 3M25 11l-3 3M14 22l-3 3"/><circle cx="18" cy="18" r="2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>

classes.name: Priest
classes.hook: Heals the living, calls back the fallen, and answers their killers with shadow. The party's reviver and second-line damage dealer.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M18 4v28M10 14h16"/><path d="M10 20a8 8 0 0 0 16 0"/><circle cx="18" cy="9" r="2.2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>

classes.name: Enchanter
classes.hook: Lulls foes to sleep so the party can pick its fights. Drowse opens packs without alerting them. Arcane Jolt wakes targets only when you decide they should die.
classes.svgIcon: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M9 7h18M11 11h14M13 15h10"/><path d="M14 19l8 8M14 27l8-8"/><circle cx="22" cy="9" r="1.5" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
